replacements.p1-r0: SME Technology Development (R&D) Support Project Research and Development Plan
replacements.p1-r2: Development of a RAG-based Business-Specialized Real-time Multilingual Translation and Interpretation AI Solution - A Global Sales, Consultation, Interpretation, and Documentation Automation Integrated Platform for Export Revenue Innovation for SMEs
replacements.p1-r4: Implementation of Business-Specialized AI Model: Develop a RAG-based Multilingual Translation and Interpretation Model trained on unique enterprise knowledge (product names, technical specifications, prices, etc.) and an End-to-End (E2E) real-time streaming voice interpretation model (for more than 8 languages) with a delay of less than 2 seconds. Full-cycle automation for export operations: Develop 5 types of export document automatic generation agents such as quotations and product pages. Unique Regulatory Certification Formatting: Build a SaaS platform integrating complex regulatory certification document formatting modules such as eCTD, KC, CE, FCC to eliminate global entry barriers for SMEs and achieve sales innovation
replacements.p1-r6: [Core Differentiating Data] Utilize an exclusive corpus of 1.1 million sentence pairs (600,000 business + 500,000 regulatory certifications) that cannot be replicated in a short period for domain-specialized fine-tuning to establish a formidable entry barrier. [AI Model Enhancement] Combine RAG technology injecting enterprise-specific knowledge into NLLB/EXAONE-based hybrid language models to reduce hallucinations by 70%. Secure simultaneous interpretation performance within 2-second delay using InfiniSST and Whisper-based technology. [SaaS Platform Commercialization] Develop a cloud SaaS web, mobile, API integrated environment leveraging the validated AI platform (Oz-i) infrastructure of the leading agency to enable user companies to link and use their data within three days without IT personnel.
replacements.p2-r0: [Lead] PCN Co., Ltd. (Platform/Commercialization Management): An AI company with 25 years of experience (270 billion KRW sales) having GS-certified platforms, possessing the Oz-i AI platform, and extensive know-how in various R&D projects, ensuring SaaS platform implementation, API integration, and cloud infrastructure commercialization. [Co-Leader①] Stunning Box Co., Ltd. (AI Model/Data Focus): An AI translation data company with 15 years of accumulated specialized datasets, responsible for AI translation fine-tuning and provision of proprietary corpus as a core asset, and multi-agent regulatory certification formatting technology. [Co-Leader②] 3 Demand Enterprises (Field Demonstration Verification): Companies awarded for excellence in exports such as Sunlight Ilukom Co., Ltd. (Automotive Parts), Genuine Grip Co., Ltd. (Special Shoes), Grey Whale (K-Beauty), provide empirical data for 3 industries and quantitatively verify the adoption effect through A/B testing.
replacements.p2-r2: [Economic and Industrial Impact] Improve the export bidding success rate of user companies by over 20% and markedly reduce the regulatory certification document processing period from the current 4-8 weeks to 1-2 weeks. Generate a revenue of 22 billion KRW in the 5th year of commercialization (cumulative 68 billion KRW over 5 years), create 51 new jobs, and plan to distribute to over 500 SMEs through AI vouchers and KOTRA linkage. Achieve a cumulative export substitution effect of 44 billion KRW over 5 years. [Securing World-Class Technology] Attain over 65 BLEU in translation accuracy, less than 2-second delay in voice interpretation, and over 70% document structure preservation rate (TEDS) to capture the B2B domain-specialized translation and interpretation market unaddressed by global big tech (Google, DeepL).

replacements.p4-r3: Development of an integrated platform enabling SMEs to easily globally trade, translate documents, and interpret using their own data
replacements.p4-r46: Scenario for small and medium enterprise infiltration
replacements.p4-r54: Product Name and Pricing Policy Implementation
replacements.p4-r59: Automatic Construction of Multilingual Shopping Mall
replacements.p4-r64: Batch Automatic Generation of Export Documents
replacements.p4-r66: Web・Mobile App・Zoom/Teams Plugin・Shopping Mall API (Cafe24・Amazon・Shopify)・CRM/ERP Integration・Offline Exhibition Mode
replacements.p4-r86: Commercialization: 6 billion KRW revenue in 1st year | 32 billion KRW revenue at 5th year, employment of 51 people | Approximately 44 billion KRW cumulative over 5 years compared to exports
replacements.p4-r87: 1) Background and Necessity of Business Promotion
replacements.p4-r89: Export SMEs face complex barriers such as translations not reflecting company-specific work contexts in overseas sales processes, unsuitable interpretation structures for real-time consultations, and high cost/long-duration regulatory documentation compliance. Therefore, an AI platform specialized in domain-specific tasks that connects the entire export cycle with company data and terminology beyond mere translation features is necessary.
replacements.p4-r94: General-purpose AI does not adequately reflect company-specific product names, technical specifications, pricing, and contract terms, risking critical information mistranslation during negotiation and contract processes.
replacements.p4-r95: Integration of company-specific product DBs, price lists, and glossaries with RAG to reflect translation, interpretation, and document generation in real-time.
replacements.p4-r97: The existing 3-step structure of STT→MT→TTS accumulates delays of 2~5 seconds or more and has limitations in handling background noise, speaker separation, and specialized terminology.
replacements.p4-r98: Implement real-time interpretation within 2 seconds using E2E streaming architecture with speaker separation and specialized terminology injection.
replacements.p4-r100: CE, eCTD, FCC, HACCP, etc., have complex country-specific formats and document structures, with preparation time and outsourcing costs being a significant burden for SMEs.
replacements.p4-r101: Automate translation, structuring, and formatting of regulatory documents and support the creation of submission documents based on expert review (HITL).
replacements.p4-r102: (2) Market Growth and Urgency of Development
replacements.p4-r103: ◦ The global business AI translation market is expected to grow from approximately $1.8 billion in 2025 to over $7 billion by 2030, with demand for business domain specialization rapidly expanding.
